_meta.status: ILLUSTRATIVE PROPOSAL — models the STRUCTURE of real development control, using UDCPR 2020 (Maharashtra) as the reference. Figures are from published UDCPR/Nagpur tables but are NOT a substitute for the sanctioned DCR of your target authority. Verify every value. This file does NOT work with the current rules engine — see the note at the bottom.
_meta.reference: UDCPR 2020, Chapter 6 (marginal distances & FSI). See FINDINGS.md (DCR reference section).
_meta.why_this_exists: The v1 config (config/bylaws.json) uses flat scalar setbacks/FSI. Real DCR does not: setbacks are slab tables varying by road width and building height; FSI is decomposed (basic + premium + TDR + ancillary) with exemptions. This shows the gap — the rework is the SCHEMA, not just the numbers.

front_setback_m.rule: take the greater of the road-width band and the height override

side_rear_setback_m.rule: by building-height band (UDCPR Table 6-D, apartments/other buildings) — these are FORMULAS, not constants
side_rear_setback_m.long_building_adjustment: if building length or depth > 40 m, add 10% of (that dimension - 4) to the margin on the affected side(s)

by_abutting_road_width_m.note: no fixed cap; high-rise (>24 m) needs CFO NOC + structural review

fsi.note: FSI is NOT one number — it is a stack, and each layer is computed on a different plot basis.

basic.plot_basis: net plot AFTER deducting road setback & amenity/reservation

computation.method: P-line — outer periphery of construction, computed floor-wise
excluded_from_fsi: balconies up to the permitted percentage
service / utility areas listed in UDCPR Reg. 6.8
computation.note: each exclusion has its own cap/condition; they are not a flat allowance

ground_coverage.note: UDCPR governs coverage INDIRECTLY through the marginal distances above, not via a single permissible %. A flat coverage % (as in v1) does not map cleanly.

parking_ecs.rule: table-based by use and carpet-area band per tenement — NOT a flat 1 ECS/unit
parking_ecs.note: e.g. tenements above a carpet-area threshold require more ECS each; visitor parking is additional

_rules_engine_rework_required: Setback checks must LOOK UP a value (by road width, by height band) and EVALUATE formulas (H/2-4, H/3), not compare against a constant.
Height check must derive the cap from road width.
FSI check must decompose basic/premium/TDR/ancillary, apply the correct plot basis to each, and subtract P-line exemptions — a real computation, not built-up ÷ plot.
Inputs must grow: abutting road width, building length/depth, per-unit carpet areas, zone/use.
Ground coverage as a flat % should probably be dropped in favour of the marginal-distance envelope.
